style: Stylized heroic fantasy painting in the look of a hand-painted 2D animated fantasy cinematic short: bold simplified shapes, slightly heroic sturdy proportions (broad shoulders, solid armour and props), heavy confident painterly brush strokes, hand-painted textures, rich saturated colour with a limited palette per scene, strong warm rim light against deep cool shadows, big areas of calm empty darkness, atmospheric haze between clear foreground, middle ground and background layers, cinematic widescreen composition. No ink outlines and no comic line art: edges are defined only by paint and light. Grounded anatomy and believable faces with real weight and emotion, semi-realistic like a painted cinematic short, not a cartoon, not a comic, not photorealistic, not a book illustration. Full-bleed image edge to edge: no black bars, no letterbox, no text, no letters, no logos, no borders, no frame, no watermark.

cast.lucien: Lucien Vale, a young half-elf wild magic sorcerer who loves to sing and play music, a good-hearted man who was betrayed: long straight blond hair, pointed elf ears, clean-shaven open friendly face, warm kind eyes carrying quiet sorrow, weary from betrayal, a faint gentle smile that does not hide his sadness, burgundy velvet long coat with brass buttons over a dark shirt, leather belt with a dagger whose blade glows faintly blue, faint purple arcane sparks flickering at his fingertips, a lute on his back, slim build. Sympathetic hero, never sinister or villainous
cast.arthas: Arthas, a tall devout human paladin: full dark steel plate armour, a dark cloth hood always worn up over a closed steel helm (hood visible in every view), two burning orange eye slits, broad shoulders, heavy bronze-hilted longsword, a faded holy sun emblem on his chest
cast.cedric: Cedric 'Cold-Eye', a human monk: shaved head, short dark beard, hard pale grey eyes, red and brown leather monk wraps over a green tunic, one bronze dragon-shaped shoulder pauldron, prayer beads, a long wooden staff, wiry strong build
cast.mara: Mara, Lucien's only real friend: a strong, curvy, attractive barkeep in her thirties, broad shoulders and strong arms, thick auburn hair tied back, freckles, warm confident eyes, rolled-up linen sleeves, a leather apron and laced bodice, a tavern woman who can throw a drunk out by herself
cast.valerys: Oathbreaker Valerys, the High Inquisitor fallen: a tall man in his sixties, close-cropped grey hair and short grey beard, hard pale grey eyes, his white and crimson inquisitor robes and gold sun emblem blackened and cracked, dark corrupted plate beneath, a cold dark fire and pale light burning around him
cast.wizard: a Scarlet Wizard: a gaunt sorcerer with a shaved head covered in red arcane tattoos, layered blood-red robes with gold trim, cold eyes, fire or mist curling from his hands
cast.giant: the chained giant: an enormous ogre-like brute four times a man's height, grey warty skin, small eyes, heavy iron chains and shackles on its limbs and neck, goblins in leather riding on its shoulders holding chain reins
cast.serpent: the serpent: a colossal pale worm-like serpent rising from the earth, ridged grey-white hide, a huge round mouth ringed with teeth, dirt and stones falling from it
cast.duncastle: Duncastle, the Church's fortress between the forest and the plains: grey stone curtain walls with crenellations, square towers with ballistae on top, a tall timber-framed tower with a red tiled roof in the courtyard, wooden palisades, stables with a red roof
